summary: List available RFI status filter options
description: Returns a list of status filter fields and options for RFIs on a specified Project

key.description: Status string value to pass as a filter parameter, e.g. `open`, `draft`, `closed`. Use as `filters[status][]=<key>` on the RFI list endpoint.

value.description: Human-readable display label for the status, suitable for showing in a filter UI.
